disambiguation: Not just a visual display, it provides a full Neovim editing environment within the Obsidian tab.
extras: Desktop only. Mobile is not supported.
problem: Users must switch between the Obsidian interface and an external editor to perform advanced text editing.
summary: Allows users to edit Obsidian notes within an embedded Neovim instance inside an Obsidian tab, providing a full Neovim environment.
